narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -7.77 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.03340-0.03402 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip) — the trigger is still pending. Risk is defined beyond 0.03421; the first objective pays 0.54R at 0.03323.

plan.triggerRule: await bearish footprint confirmation (absorption / strong divergence / trap) or wall+CVD confluence at 0.03340-0.03402
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.03421 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 R 1.02 < 1.5 — reward does not pay the risk

basis.coinbaseReason: Coinbase premium tracked for BTC/ETH/SOL only

notes: taker buyVolUsd/sellVolUsd = Binance base-asset taker volume converted at the perp last price
funding: no per-venue OI available — oiWeightedRate8h is the equal-weight mean
funding rates are percent per interval; annualizedAprPct = oiWeightedRate8h(%) x 3 x 365
fundingImpliedAprPct is the funding-implied carry (oiWeightedRate8h annualized) — NOT a basis APR
